about.text: A bill to amend the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 to require each authorized committee or leadership PAC of a former candidate for election for Federal office to disburse all of the remaining funds of the committee or PAC after the election, and for other purposes.

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Rules and Administration.

effective.note: Not enacted as of the date of the data (stage reached: Introduced). A bill becomes law only when both chambers pass the same text and the President signs it, lets it become law without a signature, or is overridden. It has no effective date.
